title: VERINA: Benchmarking Verifiable Code Generation
authors_zh: Zhe Ye, Zhengxu Yan, Jingxuan He, Timothe Kasriel, Kaiyu Yang, Dawn Song
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** 189 Lean tasks provide code, specifications, proofs, and tests for modular and end-to-end vericoding.
189 个 Lean 任务同时提供代码、规格、证明和测试，支持模块化与端到端 vericoding。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Ordinary code benchmarks verify only that implementations pass tests, which neither establishes complete specifications nor proves correctness for all allowed inputs. Formal-proof benchmarks usually provide a theorem and do not require models to jointly generate implementations, specifications, and proofs of their alignment.

VERINA decomposes verifiable code generation into code, specification, and proof modules and their combinations. Every task includes natural language, a reference implementation, formal specifications, and tests, enabling precise attribution of end-to-end failures.

普通代码 benchmark 只验证实现是否通过测试，不能保证规格完整，也不能证明代码在所有允许输入上满足规格。形式证明 benchmark 又常只给定定理，未同时要求模型生成实现、规格和二者一致性的证明。

VERINA 将可验证代码生成拆成 code、specification 和 proof 三个模块及其组合任务，为每题同时提供自然语言、参考实现、形式规格和测试，使端到端失败可以被精确归因。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: VERINA contains 189 manually curated Lean programming tasks with detailed descriptions, signatures, reference implementations, formal pre/postconditions, proof goals, and extensive tests. It evaluates CodeGen, SpecGen, and ProofGen independently and can feed generated artifacts into downstream stages to measure compositional error. Data and code are released, and the project currently lists ICLR 2026. The data object is a problem–code–specification–proof–test/Lean-result record for modular vericoding evaluation.

VERINA 含 189 个手工整理的 Lean 编程任务，每题提供详细问题描述、函数签名、参考实现、形式化前/后置条件、证明目标和广泛测试。benchmark 可独立评测 CodeGen、SpecGen、ProofGen，也可把生成 artifact 作为下游输入测试组合误差。数据与代码开放，项目当前标注 ICLR 2026。其 data object 是“问题—代码—规格—证明—测试/Lean 检查结果”，适用于模块化 vericoding 评测。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Curate programming tasks: Tasks with clear functional behavior are selected, and natural-language descriptions and Lean signatures are written manually.
  1. Build four artifacts: Each item receives reference code, a formal specification, a machine-checkable proof, and tests covering ordinary and boundary inputs.
  1. Evaluate tasks independently: Models generate code, specifications, or proofs. Code is checked by tests and Lean typing, specifications for soundness and completeness, and proofs by kernel compilation.
  1. Test compositional context: CodeGen receives reference or generated specifications, and SpecGen receives code, measuring how upstream artifact quality propagates.
  1. Aggregate results: Code correctness, specification success, and proof success are reported per task under one or multiple samples.

1. 整理编程题： 作者选择具有清晰函数行为的任务，人工编写自然语言说明和 Lean 签名。
  1. 建立四类 artifact： 为每题实现参考代码、形式规格、机器可检查证明和覆盖正常/边界输入的测试。
  1. 独立任务评测： 分别让模型生成代码、规格或证明；代码由测试与 Lean 类型检查，规格检查 soundness/completeness，证明由内核编译。
  1. 组合上下文实验： 给 CodeGen 提供参考或生成规格，给 SpecGen 提供代码，再评估上游 artifact 质量如何传播。
  1. 统一统计： 以每题单次或多次采样的 code correctness、spec success 和 proof success 汇总。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The current ICLR 2026 project page reports one-sample results for OpenAI o3: 72.6% code correctness, 52.3% specification soundness and completeness, and only 4.9% proof success. Thus, test-passing code is much more common than complete specifications and machine proofs. An earlier arXiv version reported 61.4%, 51.0%, and 3.6% for o4-mini, so versions must be distinguished. Lean's kernel and tests provide deterministic evidence, although manually written specifications may still be incomplete.

当前 ICLR 2026 项目页的单次采样结果显示，最佳 OpenAI o3 的代码正确率为 72.6%，规格 soundness/completeness 为 52.3%，证明成功率仅 4.9%。这说明测试可通过的代码远多于可生成完整规格和机器证明的任务。早期 arXiv 版本曾报告 o4-mini 的 61.4%、51.0% 和 3.6%，引用时必须区分版本。Lean 内核和测试提供确定性证据，但人工规格本身仍可能有缺口。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing vericoding benchmarks often require only proof completion or treat specifications as given. VERINA builds a modular artifact graph for each task: code, specifications, and proofs can be generated independently or used as context for one another, exposing error propagation. The novelty is not Lean verification itself but the manually curated combination of implementations, specifications, proofs, tests, and decomposed evaluation.
已有 vericoding benchmark 常只要求补证明，或把规格视为给定。VERINA 的变化是建立同一题目的模块化 artifact graph：代码、规格和证明可单独生成，也可相互作为上下文，从而测量 error propagation。新意不是 Lean 验证本身，而是同时具备参考实现、规格、证明和测试的手工数据，以及分解式评测协议。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Scale and domain: The 189 Lean functional-programming tasks do not represent systems code, stateful programs, or other proof languages.
  1. Specification completeness: Reference specifications encode manually selected behavior and may omit user intent. A proof establishes only the stated specification.
  1. Version drift: The project page updates models and numbers relative to early arXiv versions. Reproduction must record VERINA, Lean, Mathlib, and model snapshots.

1. 规模与领域： 189 题为 Lean 函数式编程任务，不能代表系统代码、状态ful程序或其他证明语言。
  1. 规格完备性： benchmark 的 reference spec 是人工选择的行为边界，可能未表达全部用户意图；通过证明只说明满足该规格。
  1. 版本漂移： 项目页与早期 arXiv 的模型和数字已更新。复现实验必须记录 VERINA、Lean、Mathlib 与模型 snapshot。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Modular evaluation: Measure code, specifications, and proofs separately so low proof success is not confused with code inability or vice versa.
  1. Formal training data: Use reference artifacts for SFT and turn compiler-error repair into verifier-guided trajectories, keeping benchmark tests isolated.
  1. Compositional-error research: Feed model-generated specifications to code generators or provers and compare reference versus generated context to quantify upstream error propagation.

1. 模块化评测： 分别测 code、spec 和 proof，避免用低 proof success 笼统否定代码能力或反之。
  1. 形式训练数据： 用 reference artifact 做 SFT，并把编译错误—修复过程转为 verifier-guided trajectories；测试集应隔离。
  1. 组合误差研究： 将模型生成规格提供给代码模型或证明器，比较 reference 与 generated context，量化上游错误传播。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: 189 Lean tasks provide code, specifications, proofs, and tests for modular and end-to-end vericoding.
  1. Method hook: Separate scoring and compositional-context experiments across three artifact types locate error propagation.
  1. Data hook: Problems, signatures, reference implementations, pre/postconditions, proofs, and boundary tests are manually curated.
  1. Evidence anchor: The current best reaches 72.6% code, 52.3% specification, and only 4.9% proof success.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits formal code generation after freezing the ICLR release, Lean/Mathlib, and model snapshot.

1. 一句话定位： 189 个 Lean 任务同时提供代码、规格、证明和测试，支持模块化与端到端 vericoding。
  1. 方法抓手： 三类 artifact 分开判分并进行组合上下文实验，才能定位错误传播。
  1. 数据抓手： 手工整理问题、签名、参考实现、前后置条件、证明和边界测试。
  1. 证据锚点： 当前最佳代码 72.6%、规格 52.3%，证明仅 4.9%。
  1. 复用决定： 适合形式代码生成；复用前冻结 ICLR 版数据、Lean/Mathlib 和模型 snapshot。
